answer: Reputation-weighted routing: each identity's message reach grows only through verified past deliveries, so new identities start near zero reach. To be heard, an attacker must run real work through a vine of slow, audited relays that raises their cost per fake identity above the payoff. Honest participants spread cheaply across the meadow of established routes, while every cloned identity needs its own history. This makes forgery a crystal of accumulating labor, not a fee.
